list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An isostructural discrete cluster with three Cp*-capped Gd(III) ions and one Li ion connected by four μ₂-Cl, two μ₃-Cl, and one μ₄-Cl bridges to form a distorted heterometallic tetrahedron. Two THF and one diethyl ether molecules are coordinated.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon using Schlenk or glovebox techniques, an equimolar mixture of Cp*Li and anhydrous GdCl3 was dispersed in THF/diethyl ether (1:9) and stirred overnight at room temperature. The LiCl precipitate was filtered off and the solvent evaporated under vacuum.
synthesis.time: stirred overnight; crystals after approximately one day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk techniques or glovebox under argon; slow solvent evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter off LiCl, evaporate solvent under vacuum, dissolve the residue in 5 mL diethyl ether, and slowly evaporate to obtain single crystals.
